name: Cushion Court
summary: A low cushion-shaped prayer hall and a clearly shouldered minaret make an approachable solid mosque.
why: The minaret overlaps the broad hall and its collar physically meets the shaft. Dome and doorway share x=62, while the tall tower balances the low right-hand mass.
risk: The rounded architecture feels friendly and contemporary rather than historically specific.
sub1: The tower grows out of the prayer hall
sub2: A large true opening keeps the mark clear
reasonToChoose: A low cushion-shaped prayer hall and a clearly shouldered minaret make an approachable solid mosque.
